h1: Wix app conversion, from install to active site
overview: We walk through your app as a new site owner and note every point where someone might give up. Then we fix them: a shorter first-run flow, a setup checklist, clearer plan names and limits, upgrade prompts at the right moment and tracking to see what works. We keep the screens honest and follow Wix App Market rules for pricing and reviews.

faq: Can you promise more paid installs?
No. Results depend on your app, pricing and traffic. We remove friction we can see, add tracking so you can measure it and report honestly on what the numbers show.
Do you work with the pricing plans in my Dev Center?
Yes. We review the plans you have, suggest clearer names and limits, and update the screens that show them. Changes to the plans themselves are made by you or in your account with your approval.
Can you ask site owners for reviews?
Only in ways Wix allows. We add one polite prompt after a good moment and never offer rewards or filter who is asked. Reviews must come from real site owners.
What do you track events with?
Whatever you already use, such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel or PostHog. With nothing in place, we suggest a free option and set up events for the steps that matter.
